hypothesis: After accepted promotion is dispatched, caller cancellation cannot be silently converted into success: unjournaled publication drains then propagates cancellation under a recovery fence, while journaled publication defers cancellation through commit and reports it.
cases: a caller cancellation suppressed by an unjournaled hook is propagated after the hook drains and fences reentry
repeated caller cancellations preserve the durable round reservation until commit
repeated unjournaled cancellation is delivered to hook cleanup only once
a hook that suppresses its own cancellation without clearing task state is fenced
journaled hook self-cancellation retains the prepared recovery state and fences reentry
publication failure after deferred caller cancellation takes precedence and retains recovery state
the additive RoundResult field appears in ordinary JSON serialization with default zero
acceptance: Pinned main reproduces all seven semantic/API failures; the candidate passes all seven cases without setup errors or skips. Journaled completion after caller cancellation returns the committed RoundResult with deferred_cancellation_count and one promotion_cancellation_deferred event. Unjournaled cancellation is propagated only after the owned hook is terminal; only one cancellation is delivered to hook cleanup, and publication failure or hook self-cancellation fences reentry while clearing consumed caller cancellation state.
budget: Deterministic asyncio fixtures and local SQLite only; no model, accelerator, paid API, or network dependency; each comparison subprocess is limited to 30 seconds.
stopping_rule: Retain the first baseline and matched candidate results. Do not alter expected outcomes after observing them; preserve every negative result.
limits: One event loop, one process, and trusted cooperative hooks. Cancellation after publication dispatch cannot roll back publication. No multi-host atomicity, detached-worker termination, hard cancellation deadline, hostile-hook containment, or model-quality improvement is claimed.
